mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, entry_id, total_fee, payment_method, payment_gateway, paid, status, cancelled, payment_time, transaction_id, merchant_uid, imp_uid, car_number ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{entryId}, #{totalFee}, #{paymentMethod}, #{gateway}, #{paid}, #{status}, #{cancelled}, #{paymentTime}, #{transactionId}, #{merchantUid}, #{impUid}, #{carNumber} )
mapper.select: SELECT point, point_expire_next_month AS pointExpireNextMonth, prepaid_balance AS prepaidBalance, last_charged_at AS lastChargedAt, monthly_usage AS monthlyUsage, compare_last_month AS compareLastMonth FROM account_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p JOIN entry_log el ON el.payment_id = p.payment_id JOIN car c ON el.car_id = c.car_id
AND c.member_id = #{req.memberId}
AND p.payment_time >= #{req.startDate}
AND p.payment_time <= CONCAT(#{req.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND p.paid =
1 0
AND ( CAST(p.payment_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR p.payment_method LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') )

SELECT p.payment_id AS id, p.car_number AS carNumber, m.name AS payer, CASE WHEN s.subscription_id IS NOT NULL THEN '월주차' ELSE '일반' END AS paymentType, p.total_fee AS amount, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.payment_time AS paidAt, CASE WHEN p.paid = 1 THEN '완료' ELSE '실패' END AS status FROM payment p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN subscription s ON s.member_id = m.member_id AND s.active = 1
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR p.car_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') )
AND p.paid =
1 0
ORDER BY p.payment_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p LEFT JOIN parking_log pl ON p.payment_id = pl.payment_id LEFT JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN subscription s ON s.member_id = m.member_id AND s.active = 1
AND ( m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') OR pl.car_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%') )
AND p.paid =
1 0
